minutes.headline: Zoning Board granted a special permit letting a car wash put its sign at the front property line.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for a car wash on Electric Avenue to place a freestanding sign at the front property line.
The permit carries the standard condition that the car wash comply with all other regulations.
The board proceeded with four members, so a grant needed a supermajority of all four.
Members said the new granite curb and the sign's placement made sense, before the motion was made and seconded.

why_it_matters: The decision lets one business put a sign closer to the street than the 20-foot front setback normally allows, which touches how that stretch of Electric Avenue looks; it has no effect on tax bills or town services.
